content.text:
I fixed the about page on phones by deleting one stray CSS rule from `site/css/pages.css`. I didn't open the page at phone width, so the layout fix itself is unchecked. The 16 functional tests pass, but they don't test the mobile layout.

The rule was `.story { grid-template-columns: 1fr 480px; }`, sitting after the `@media (max-width: 720px)` block. It overrode the mobile single-column layout. On a phone, the "How it started" section kept a fixed 480px image column, so the page overflowed sideways. With the rule gone, that section stacks into one column at 720px and below, as the media query intends. Desktop layout is unchanged, because the same two-column rule is already defined earlier in the file.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't confirm from history that this rule was the last change.

STATUS: DONE
